name: Bright Shine

features.text: Contains special agents to promote an even, streak-free finish.

description: A VOC-compliant, silicone-based dressing that leaves a glossy, long-lasting, water-resistant shine. This dressing helps restore, beautify, and protect tires, trim, moldings, and other exterior surfaces. Bright Shine also restores rubber and plastic surfaces depleted by UV damage.
application: Make sure tires or trim are clean and dry before applying product. 1.) Apply product with a trigger sprayer, sponge, or brush until there is complete coverage. 2.) Allow product to dry and wipe away excess with a clean towel (to prevent "sling"). Important! Excess product and improper application of dressings on tires may result in product “sling” or splatter which can stain adjacent painted surfaces of a vehicle.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Gloss - 8 Durability - 3
